description:
Import ERC-8004 Reputation Registry feedback records for an agent.
    Each item: {value: bool|0..1, at: ISO-8601, source?, weight?, feedback_id?}.
    Idempotent per feedback_id.

chain_id.description: EVM chain id where the ERC-8004 registry lives, for example 8453 for Base.
chain_id.title: Chain Id

feedback.description: Feedback items: {value: true/false or 0..1, at: ISO-8601, source?, weight?, feedback_id?}.
feedback.title: Feedback

token_id.description: The agent's ERC-721 token id in the Identity Registry.
token_id.title: Token Id

name: import_feedback
title: Import feedback
